scope: Proposed conductor-budget contract only; not pin assignment or actual clone continuity
policy: At most 21 physical B01 header routes are connected: sixteen retained roles, JOY_VCC and at most four parallel returns.
Every other B01 header pad remains physically unconnected to carrier, mounting metal, clamps and service wiring; no VIN/3V3 injection is authorized.

Reserve a separate path for every one of the 24 possible USB-C contact positions and shell, even if the exact captive RUN connection later omits some. This is a conservative budget, not a statement that all 24 contacts are populated or functional.
All chosen physical routes traverse both full-route breakpoints; a shared net name does not waive a parallel physical conductor.
No additional shield, test/debug, mount-metal or service bypass is allowed; any new route consumes the remaining capacity and invalidates this budget if the total exceeds 50.
RUN remains through B01 USB-C. At no point does this contract authorize GPIO/pad mapping, actual connector wiring or a schematic.
unresolved: Product adoption of the captive RUN/PROGRAM mechanism
Exact B01 header and RUN-USB connection part, connection drawings and route list
Whether the exact clone supports every retained role without excluded pins
Physical connector fit and verified clearance for every metal part
Actual terminal ratings, return/current sharing, JOY inrush and USB behavior
